The Mayflash Universal Fighting Stick IS A CHEAP PIECE OF CRAP . I say it as someone who plays shmups and fighting games on almost on a daily basis and has been doing it for the past 9 years, has bought one of these and modded it after it went bad.

I give it six months before the stick craps, the buttons start getting stuck and mushy - worse, fixing/updating it with quality parts will involve soldering and physically modifying the internals in order to make the pieces fit - this is, if you're lucky of the PCB not crapping itself. Also, because the technology has marched on, you'll be hard pressed to find a leveler that fits it (i.e. a Japanese one, american/euro-style joysticks are too big to fit the case and too heavy to mount on plastic) that still uses individual connections for each micro-switch, as all in production use 5-pin mounts these days - you'll have to go the Frankenstein route by buying switches separately to replace it on the leveler, which is another headache about finding which gives you the operational feeling you're looking for.
